topic: The decade gap — EU house prices vs. rents, 2015–Q3 2025

drafts.text: Ten years, one chart. EU house prices +64.9%. Rents +21.8% (Eurostat, 2015–Q3 2025). Same decade, same market — the gap between those lines is not a coincidence, it's a margin. Rent eats first — coming to the menu. https://data-snack.com
